MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #4
====

GRADE: PP2
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 3 cm and 4 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 1
   B. 5
   C. 7
   D. 7

2. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 65
   B. 64
   C. 16
   D. 0

3. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 7
   C. 50
   D. 49

4. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 10
   D. 4

5. Solve for x: x + 3 = 9. (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 3
   C. 9
   D. 6

6. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 24
   C. 12
   D. 36

7. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 17
   C. 0
   D. 8

8. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 11
   C. 5
   D. 24

9. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

10. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 36
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 81

11. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 40
   B. 400
   C. 4
   D. 10

12. What is the square of 13? (1 mark)
   A. 170
   B. 26
   C. 169
   D. 13

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. Show full working: A trader sells 12 items at Ksh 90 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

14. Show full working: A trader sells 13 items at Ksh 95 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

15. Show full working: A trader sells 14 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

16. Show full working: A trader sells 15 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

Working:
1. Formula / relationship: c² = a² + b²
2. Substitute values: c² = 3² + 4²
3. c² = 9 + 16
4. c² = 25
5. c = 5
Final Answer: 5 cm
Mark reminder: method mark for Pythagoras; accuracy mark for hypotenuse
